import numpy as np
r=np.array(df['dA_dt']);A=np.array(df['A']);t=np.array(df['t'])
edges=np.linspace(0.5,10,11)
for i in range(10):
    m=(t>=edges[i])&(t<edges[i+1])
    if m.sum()<5: continue
    X=np.column_stack([np.ones(m.sum()),np.log(A[m])])
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,np.log(r[m]),rcond=None)[0]
    res=np.log(r[m])-X@c
    # also quadratic in logA
    X2=np.column_stack([np.ones(m.sum()),np.log(A[m]),np.log(A[m])**2])
    c2=np.linalg.lstsq(X2,np.log(r[m]),rcond=None)[0]
    print(round(edges[i],2),m.sum(),'order',round(c[1],3),'resid',round(res.std(),4),'quad',np.round(c2,3),round((np.log(r[m])-X2@c2).std(),4))
